caption: The drawing depicts an architectural detail, likely a decorative bracket or corbel, rendered in a three-dimensional perspective. The structure is triangular in form, designed to fit into a corner, with its flat top represented as a horizontal surface. The top edge features a narrow brown band bordered beneath by a thin green stripe. The main faces of the bracket are divided into decorative panels, predominantly colored green, pinkish-red, and white. The central section of the underside is a deep green with a yellow-orange floral motif. Pinkish-red borders follow the contours of the structure, edged with white molding, accentuating the geometric lines and arches. Additional green panels on the side faces contain small yellow floral decorations. The overall background of the image is a plain off-white, and the artist's name, "Edward T. Jewett," is printed in small text at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Wall Bracket (Eccleasiastical)
